patch_description: Returns to the stronger, faster-converging nearest-neighbor CZ backbone and adds a second compact phase-entangling sandwich. The original per-wire RY and first post-RZ parameters preserve local expressivity, while the added RZ layers use even/odd sharing, introducing only four parameter identities per repetition. This is substantially shallower and lower-gate than the current long-range two-stage mixer while retaining dual entangling phases.
